name: agcrypto
description: Passerelle de paiement crypto : backend (API) + frontend (tableaux de bord)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db: docker compose up -d --wait && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
